final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT Laboratory.ID, Patient.SEX, AVG(Laboratory.ALB) as col3, AVG(CASE WHEN Laboratory.UN IS NOT NULL AND Laboratory.[T-BIL] IS NOT NULL THEN CAST(Laboratory.UN AS REAL) / Laboratory.[T-BIL] ELSE NULL END) as col4 FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.SEX IS NOT NULL AND Patient.SEX != '' GROUP BY Laboratory.ID, Patient.SEX), step2 AS (SELECT SEX as col1, AVG(col3) as col2, AVG(col4) as col3 FROM step1 GROUP BY SEX), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(col2) as col1 FROM step2) SELECT step2.col1, step2.col2, step2.col3, step2.col2 - step3.col1 as col4 FROM step2, step3 WHERE step3.col1 IS NOT NULL AND step2.col2 > step3.col1
